sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: Lumen: solar smart garden planter (Technology, goal $25,000). The committee recommends Do Not Invest at 61% confidence.

sections.title: Market Opportunity
sections.body: Negative (score 10/100). Technology campaigns fund at 24% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 0.59). Market timing is unfavorable; the Technology trend is declining (21,646 campaigns). The category is crowded.

sections.title: Competitive Position
sections.body: Negative (score 17/100). Ask for less: funded campaigns' median goal is $10,000 vs $20,000 for those that failed. Your $25,000 goal is 2.5x the winners' median ($10,000) — priced like the campaigns that failed. Category is crowded — 21,646 campaigns (8% of all).

sections.title: Founder Analysis (creator execution)
sections.body: Positive (score 75/100). The creator's controllable choices are already near their modeled optimum (40% of a reachable 53%). Craft gap: Add a number to your title (e.g. an edition or volume number) (~9 pts). Craft gap: Lower your funding goal from $25,000 to $10,000 (~3 pts).

sections.title: Financial Analysis (funding viability)
sections.body: Positive (score 64/100). Goal $25,000 is 2.5x the category winners' median ($10,000). Calibrated funding probability 40% vs the 33% decision bar. Goal-size risk (High): Goal $25,000 is 2.5x the Technology funded-median ($10,000); large goals are harder to reach.

sections.title: Risk Assessment
sections.body: Negative (score 28/100). Overall risk: High. Modeled failure risk 60%. High — Goal $25,000 is 2.5x the Technology funded-median ($10,000); large goals are harder to reach. High — Similar campaigns (Technology, a large goal) funded at only 22% (lift 0.53). 4 investor objection(s) raised; top: goal_size.

sections.title: Investment Thesis
sections.body: The committee recommends Do Not Invest at 61% confidence. Bull case (Founder): The creator's controllable choices are already near their modeled optimum (40% of a reachable 53%). Bear case (Market): Technology campaigns fund at 24% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 0.59). The campaign is already fundable (40%, reachable ~53%). The thesis is supportable, subject to standard diligence (deferred here).
